Pick up the sugar cube(s) and place them in the saucepan with hot chocolate.
Pick the boxed drink from the counter and place it in the sink. Then turn on the sink faucet.
Tilt the pan slightly to move the lemon inside the pan. Place the pan back down on the stove once finished.
Pick up the bagel from the plate, place it on the toaster oven rack, close the door, and set the timer.
Pull the toaster oven rack outwards. Pick up the baguette from the plate and place it on the toaster oven rack. Close the toaster oven door fully and set the temperature to the lowest setting.
Open the toaster oven door and place the heatable sandwich ingredients on the rack only. Make sure the cold/unheable items are still on the plate.
Open the toaster oven door. Place the baguette on the bottom rack in the toaster oven and place the turkey slice on the top rack.
Move the bread slice from the broken right slot to the working left slot-pair so both slices can toast together. Then press that lever to start toasting.
Place the fish on the bottom rack of the toaster oven, and slide the rack back inside. Close the toaster oven door and set the temperature to the max to begin broiling the fish.
Take the tongs from the drawer on the left and place them on the dining counter next to the tray containing the hot dog.
Move the pot and pan from the stove into the sink.
Press the stop button on the microwave.
Wait until the marinara sauce is simmered to a deep red color and then turn off the stove.
Turn off the sink faucet.
Turn off the front right burner of the stove.
Turn on the blender by pressing the power button.
Press down the lever to turn on the electric kettle.
Press the start button on the microwave.
Turn on the sink faucet.
Turn on the rear right burner of the stove.
Push down the lever of the toaster to turn it on.
Turn on the toaster oven by setting the timer.
Turn the sink spout to the right.
Pick and place the utensils into the open drawer.
Place the two vegetables and bowl onto the tray for setting up a vegetable dip station.
Open the microwave, place the bowl with waffle inside the microwave, then close the microwave door and turn it on.
Pick the croissant and place it on the pan. Then turn on the stove to warm the croissant.
Take the fish out of the fridge, briefly rinse it in the sink, and place it on the tray next to the sink.
Put the colander in the sink, put the peach, mango, banana in the colander, and turn on the sink faucet and pour water over the colander.
Pick up the eggplant and broccoli from the fridge and place them in the saucepan with water next to the sink for soak washing.
Wash the lettuce in the sink by running water over it.
Pick the jam and place it on the digital scale for weighing, and close the cabinet.
Pick up the sponge from the counter and wipe the counter by gripping it and pressing it against the surface. Once finished, release the sponge.
Place the yogurt and fruit onto the counter.
